name: Alosco
found: Northern Trailhead, sitting against the cracked waystone.
appearance: Lean. Crescent pendant. Staff notched with journeys.
sayings: Past the bone spiral? That's an omen. I turn back.
does_not_want: To pass the smoking bone spiral.
knows: Where the bone spiral stands, and that it was warm.
anecdotes: Led 9 Tagmira wool wagons through snow in 3 days. Lost none.
Walked Cindas north twice this month. The only militiaman who pays.
tragedies: Lost his brother Virot to a spring flood on the Tagmira road, 12 years ago. Sets a pebble on every waystone he passes, one for Virot.
dm_notes: The spiral marks Ashfang ground. Disturb it: Ashfang patrol arrives in 1d4 hours.
campaign_notes: Created 2026-10-07 in the Nemetra NPC quality test; drawn from Drive 'Nemetra Gnoll Threat'.
